content: Splitwise-style splitting supports: equal split (default, divides evenly), unequal by exact dollar amounts (must sum to total), unequal by percentage (must sum to 100%), and unequal by shares/ratio (e.g. 2 shares vs 1 share). All are variations of one core computation: total amount is allocated across a subset of members according to a weighting scheme, then each member's owed vs paid amount nets into a per-member delta for that expense.
